items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Jimmy Noon was working with Manny Perez... That's when my brother was playing there with them.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about Jimmy Noon too. Have you ever played with Jimmy down here? Sure.

Jimmy Noon was working with Manny Perez. He was nice, always was. Nice fella. A homely fella. They never catch him bumming after, you know. He and Manny Perez was playing at plays. Never catch him bumming. That's when my brother was playing there with them. But Brad Bebe, he was playing with them too, before they closed down. Jimmy Noon always was a nice fella. And Manny had a wonderful piano player, Frankie Haines. Oh yeah, I've heard of him. He was playing with them too. Manny, fella never did drink. Everything…
Jimbo must have been a pretty good reader too then, I guess. Who? Jimbo, Jimmy Noon. Jimmy Noon? Where's Brad? Yeah.
